precedence: Supporting skills are reference only (CLAUDE.md source priority item 5): they never override the work order, client facts, account data, agency policy, the approval workflow, or the safety rules.

routes.note: Collect the exact child account name, 10-digit child customer ID, and exact service before anything else.
Service examples are research prompts, not proof the client offers a service.
Take a fresh read-only snapshot first. google-ads-full:google-ads-audit scores Broad, PMax, and Display coverage; agency policy (Search, Phrase + Exact) wins.

all-skills:keyword-research pairs Broad Match with Smart Bidding; the agency default is BOFU Phrase + Exact with no Broad without explicit approval. Keyword Planner synonyms share one volume bucket; never sum them.
Two RSAs per ad group tailored to the keyword and landing page; verified claims only; 30/90 character limits; optimize for qualified leads, not Ad Strength.
Keep raw search terms out of context (aggregates only). Intent-check every negative; never auto-negative near me, quote, price, pricing, cost, best, hire, local, or emergency.
Separate primary bidding conversions from secondary diagnostics; dedupe by lead or transaction ID; read all goal layers before proposing a conversion mutation.
New offline-conversion integrations use the Data Manager API; use the legacy Google Ads upload path only after confirming developer-token eligibility. Never print lead PII.
Read LANDING_PAGE_CONTENT_WORKFLOW.md completely first. Visual and tracking QA need a real browser; curl and WebFetch can receive a captcha stub.
Monthly spend = daily x 30.4. Split CPC stats by ceiling regime and by converting vs non-converting clicks before judging a cap. Budget changes need separate approval.
Establish whether Quality Score indicts the landing page or the bid before proposing a bid change.
Every competitor claim must quote a sourced search result in context; never write plausible domains.
Performance Max is not an agency default and needs explicit approval. Choose PMax services by the typical per-job revenue of services the client offers.
Remarketing needs its own audience, consent, budget, and measurement plan; no cold Display by default.
Customer data uploads need consent confirmation and approval; never print or log customer PII.
Keep LSA, standard Search, and Maps work as separate plans with separate requirements.
Use the GA4 Data API read-only.
GA4 configuration changes are external writes and need explicit approval.

Verify fields against current official docs; if the Developer Knowledge lookup fails on credentials, fall back to WebFetch on developers.google.com. validate_only burns the same mutate quota as a real write.
Use Google's official server only. Never configure the itallstartedwithaidea google-ads-mcp server: its generic_mutate tool bypasses the client gate. Adding an MCP server needs explicit approval.

Show spend, leads, qualified leads, sales, revenue, gross profit, CPL, CPQL, CAC, ROAS, and profit after ad spend; state formulas and missing costs. Divide spend averages by calendar days. Never publish owner reports as shareable pages.
Reproduce and find the root cause before fixing. Run tests with the project venv.
Match repo idioms. Validate gm_gsa changes by direct import; the CLI exits 0 silently.

Before recommending, search the client's work order, plans, and memory for settled or EXCLUDED decisions. Score options with the CLAUDE.md decision standard (qualified-lead impact, intent, conversion evidence, measurement reliability, budget efficiency, landing-page fit, risk, reversibility) and give one recommendation, not a menu.
